mara.activity: Wake, wash up, take my prescription if due, and get dressed for work. I carry my reading glasses from the living-room side table upstairs and set them on the left nightstand when I am finished with them.
mara.intention: Start quietly and avoid waking or disturbing Daniel more than necessary.

mara.activity: Make coffee and toast, then check the weather and transit alerts on my phone at the kitchen island. I use the blue ceramic mug and leave it at the island center when I finish.
mara.intention: Follow my usual morning routine while checking for any commute problems.

mara.activity: Finish getting ready, pack my work laptop into its padded backpack, and gather my wallet, keys, transit badge, and headphones. I put the keys in the maple console's left drawer before leaving.
mara.intention: Leave the house in an orderly way without adding pressure to Daniel's morning.

mara.activity: Commute to the municipal office with my work backpack and transit badge.
mara.intention: Travel in and arrive ready for the workday.

mara.activity: Work at the municipal office, attend meetings, and review street-project maps and the revised traffic-calming proposal. I make notes about the Thursday changes and keep the deadline visible in my planner.
mara.intention: Make steady progress on the neighborhood plans without letting the deadline become overwhelming.

mara.activity: Take a quiet lunch break and check my phone for any message from home, without repeatedly interrupting Daniel.
mara.intention: Stay available while giving him space.

mara.activity: Continue meetings, map review, and revisions to the traffic-calming proposal. I organize the points that still need checking so I can finish the most important work from home this evening.
mara.intention: Complete the most time-sensitive office work and leave a manageable evening task list.

mara.activity: Commute home with my work backpack, keeping the revised proposal notes together for the evening work session.
mara.intention: Get home promptly and check on Daniel before settling into work.

mara.activity: Put my work things in bedroom two, change into leggings and a cardigan, check quietly on Daniel, and make ginger tea. I carry the tea mug to the right side of the living-room coffee table and leave it there for him.
mara.intention: Be attentive without pressing him to talk, and make sure he has something warm nearby.

mara.activity: Work from the bedroom-two desk on the neighborhood traffic-calming proposal, using my notes and map folder. I keep the door open enough to hear if Daniel needs me and take one brief pause to check that he is comfortable.
mara.intention: Meet the Thursday deadline while remaining available and restrained around Daniel's illness.

mara.activity: Bring a simple reheated dinner to the dining table and eat quietly with Daniel, leaving room for him to rest rather than expecting conversation. I use a bowl, spoon, glass, and napkin, then carry my things back toward the kitchen when I finish.
mara.intention: Have a calm meal and keep the evening effort low for both of us.

mara.activity: Wash my dinner things and do a small reset of the kitchen counter and entry. I check the tea on the coffee table and replace it with fresh ginger tea if it has gone cold.
mara.intention: Reduce visual clutter and quietly support Daniel without fussing over him.

mara.activity: Read a few chapters of my library book with tea on the living-room sofa, keeping the television off or very quiet. I glance over to check on Daniel but do not interrupt his rest.
mara.intention: Wind down while keeping the room calm and available to him.

mara.activity: Put away the tea things, wash up, and prepare for bed. I put my phone on its charger, set tomorrow's work reminder, and leave my reading glasses on the living-room side table if I am still carrying them.
mara.intention: Finish the day in a predictable way and avoid over-organizing Daniel's recovery.

mara.activity: Get into bed, read a few quiet pages, and turn out the light.
mara.intention: Sleep enough to remain patient and steady tomorrow.

daniel.activity: Wake congested and chilled, sit up slowly, drink water, and use the bathroom. Wash my hands and face before returning to the bedroom.
daniel.intention: Start carefully without spending energy on a normal morning routine.

daniel.activity: Take my allergy tablets and cold medicine with water if the label interval allows, then lie back down under the quilt.
daniel.intention: Keep symptoms controlled and avoid pretending I am ready for a normal day.

daniel.activity: Sleep or doze in bed, keeping my phone and water within reach. Answer Mara briefly if she checks in.
daniel.intention: Let my body recover while Mara follows her own morning routine.

daniel.activity: Eat a little yogurt and banana at the bedside, taking small drinks between bites. Leave the bowl and spoon on the nightstand rather than trying to clean up immediately.
daniel.intention: Get something gentle into my stomach without forcing a full breakfast.

daniel.activity: Rest quietly in bed with the television off, using tissues as needed and sending Mara a short message that I have eaten a little.
daniel.intention: Reduce stimulation and reassure Mara without making her supervise me.

daniel.activity: Get up carefully, refill my water bottle at the kitchen sink, and wash my hands. Put the used bowl and spoon in the sink.
daniel.intention: Handle one small practical task while I am already up.

daniel.activity: Lie on the sofa with the throw blanket and listen to quiet television, dozing on and off.
daniel.intention: Rest somewhere other than bed while keeping the day calm.

daniel.activity: Check my temperature and drink more water. Take another dose of cold medicine only if the label interval has passed.
daniel.intention: Monitor the illness without becoming preoccupied with it.

daniel.activity: Sleep on the sofa, leaving the phone on the coffee table and the water bottle beside me.
daniel.intention: Take a proper afternoon rest while Mara is at work.

daniel.activity: Take a slow shower, brush my teeth, and put on clean sleep clothes. Leave the used clothes in the laundry hamper.
daniel.intention: Freshen up without attempting chores or a full change into daytime clothes.

daniel.activity: Return to bed and rest, drinking water when I wake. Keep the room quiet while Mara finishes her workday.
daniel.intention: Conserve enough energy to manage a small dinner and evening check-in.

daniel.activity: Sit at the dining table and eat a small portion of Mara's prepared food, using a plate and fork. Stop if my stomach objects and drink water slowly.
daniel.intention: Have a gentle dinner without asking Mara to prepare something separate.

daniel.activity: Remain seated at the table for a short, quiet conversation with Mara, then carry my plate and fork to the kitchen sink.
daniel.intention: Stay connected without spending energy on a normal evening.

daniel.activity: Rest on the sofa with low television, leaving the remote and water within reach. Tell Mara I am going to bed early if the fatigue returns.
daniel.intention: Have quiet company nearby while avoiding a long evening.

daniel.activity: Brush my teeth slowly, wash my hands, and take any permitted evening medicine with water.
daniel.intention: Finish the day cleanly and safely without adding unnecessary tasks.

daniel.activity: Sleep in bed, keeping water, tissues, and my phone beside me for brief nighttime wake-ups.
daniel.intention: Give the illness another uninterrupted night to resolve.
